name: Moo Deng
blurb: A baby pygmy hippo at a Thai zoo who became the internet's favourite grumpy face in 2024
title: Moo Deng Meme: Meaning, Origin & the Viral Baby Hippo
description: Moo Deng is a pygmy hippo born on 10 July 2024 at Thailand's Khao Kheow Open Zoo; keeper clips made her a global meme in September 2024.
answer: Moo Deng is a real pygmy hippo, born on 10 July 2024 at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chonburi, Thailand. Her name means "bouncy pork" in Thai, the name of a pork meatball, chosen in a public poll. In September 2024 her keeper's clips of her bouncing around and pulling grumpy faces went viral, and her wet, grumpy face became a reaction meme for being small but feisty.

body: Moo Deng is a female pygmy hippo, a small species native to West Africa that is endangered in the wild, with an estimated 2,000 to 3,000 left. The zoo's staff filmed her daily life and posted it on social media; fans loved her chaotic energy, her habit of "bouncing" (deng in Thai) and her shiny, scowling face.

body.note: Her siblings are also named after pork dishes, such as Moo Toon (stewed pork) and Moo Waan (sweet pork). The name Moo Deng won a fan poll with more than 20,000 votes.

head: Date
Event
rows: Moo Deng is born at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Si Racha, Chonburi, Thailand.
Keeper videos go viral worldwide; zoo visitors double and viewing is limited to five-minute slots. The zoo moves to trademark the name.
Saturday Night Live parodies her, with Bowen Yang playing Moo Deng on Weekend Update.
The music label GMM Grammy releases an official Moo Deng song in four languages, including Thai, English and Chinese.
She appears in Google's Year in Search video for 2024.
Over 12,000 fans visit the zoo for her first birthday.

ul: Posting her angry wet face as a reaction: "me when someone wakes me up".
"Moo Deng energy": small, cute and furious at everything.
Fan art and edits of her glossy, scowling face.
Comparing pets or babies to her when they throw a tantrum.

body: Moo Deng is past her 2024 peak but still one of the most famous zoo animals online, with merchandise and a live stream run by the zoo. Her fame also had a downside: some visitors splashed water or threw objects to wake her, and the zoo put up warning signs and threatened legal action. Conservation workers have noted that the meme has so far brought little measurable funding for wild pygmy hippos.

faq.a: "Bouncy pork" in Thai. It is the name of a springy pork meatball, and fits her bouncing habit.

faq.q: Where can you see Moo Deng?
faq.a: At Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Si Racha, Chonburi province, Thailand, about 100 km southeast of Bangkok.

faq.q: Is Moo Deng a real hippo?
faq.a: Yes. Unlike many memes, she is a real pygmy hippo filmed by her zoo's staff.
